userImageObservation: Horizontal scrollbar visible at bottom of lead form popup; form itself looked acceptable but container had sideways scroll.
rootCause: Hidden honeypot anti-spam input was matched by the general input selector, inherited width:100%, and as an absolutely positioned element extended beyond the popup panel, creating internal horizontal overflow.
fix: Excluded .contact-lead-popup__honeypot from visible input selector and positioned honeypot off-screen with 1px max width; visible form structure unchanged.
